messages:
samir: Heads-up — planning a staged rollout for flag `adaptive_concurrency_v2`. Goal: reduce tail latency on heavy-seq workloads without regressing p95 for small requests. Timeline: tomorrow 09:30 PT -> canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then 100% if healthy. Rollback to `off` on errors or >5% p95 regression. Need volunteers for smoke checks + rollback readiness. @alex for metrics, @maria to run canary, @ashley for QA. Thoughts?

alex: I can own metrics. Will add a Grafana panel and two alerts: p50/p95 by route and error rate. Also will pin a temporary dashboard link in the thread before start.
maria: I can run the canary and follow the checklist. Quick q: exact intermediate flag states? safe default -> conservative -> aggressive?
samir: Correct. States: `off` -> `conservative` -> `aggressive`. Conservative limits max inflight per connection and keeps timeouts comfy. Conservative should not be breaking. Example config snippet: `feature_flags: { adaptive_concurrency_v2: "conservative" }`
ashley: I'll own smoke tests. Plan: 10 representative prompts + a 200req/s 2m burst. Will capture pre/post latency and response correctness. Can start at 09:25 PT for pre-checks.
jit: Make sure rollout uses `staged_flag` orchestrator (it supports auto-rollback on alert). I'll set rollback trigger to 10m and paste manual rollback steps here:```bash
# quick rollback
kubectl patch cm feature-flags -p '{"adaptive_concurrency_v2":"off"}'
sleep 30
# verify
kubectl get pods -l app=inference -o wide
```
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by samir for 1749082200. Canary policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Watchers: alex, maria. Will post progress updates.
alex: Added alert rule: if p95 increases >5% AND error_rate >0.5% then notify #eng-oncall and pause rollout. Also wiring slack webhook to post to #eng-platform.
maria: On canary start I'll pin the runbook and attach pre-run logs. Suggest muting non-critical infra alerts during ramp to reduce noise.
samir: Perfect. Final checklist: canary owner = maria; metrics/alerts = alex; smoke tests = ashley; rollback ops = jit. If no major regressions by 11:30 PT we proceed to 100%. I'll post a 10m "starting canary" notice in #eng-platform tomorrow. :thumbsup:
